football.definition: ordinary (non-legendary, non-Basic) individuals from their first season with at least 7 football starts and no earlier credits, followed while they keep at least 7 starts a season; nonattainers (run ended or window closed) stay in every denominator

sustained.definition: at least 6 Clash lineups in a season, from zero credits, followed while that continues

starters.definition: ordinary individuals first seen at a season start as level 5 or lower with no pro seasons, entry season 12 or earlier; level read at each following season start; anyone no longer in the league (retired, released out) counts as not reaching 50
starters.gate: at least 75% of ordinary mixed-mode starters reach level 50 within 8 seasons

cohorts.cohort: starter from the first season (7+ starts)
starter in at least 4 of the 8 seasons
starter in at least 6 of the 8 seasons
starter in all 8 seasons and in a Clash lineup at least 4 times a season on average (mixed)
